descriptions.text: Blockchain data storage protocol Serenity Shield tweeted that the MetaMask wallet associated with the project has been compromised. According to blockchain detective ZachXBT, Serenity Shield was robbed of 6.9 million SERSH tokens, valued at approximately $5,600,000.

Serenity Shield disclosed on 2024-02-27 that a project-related MetaMask wallet on BNB Chain had been compromised. Publicly linked transactions show about 6.9 million SERSH tokens moved from the wallet, followed by a rapid collapse in the token price and suspension of trading activity. A project-related MetaMask wallet controlling SERSH tokens was compromised, enabling unauthorized transfers on BNB Chain. Public reporting frequently described the event as phishing or social engineering related, but no public forensic report established the exact compromise method.
